name: Goals stage heading
does: Document title.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Single human-gated stage
does: Declares goals the pipeline's only human-gated stage.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Input heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Working directory holds description
does: Work in the mise directory, whose goals.md already holds the user's description.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Reopened artifacts revised not regenerated
does: Existing goals or mock artifacts are revised with the user, never regenerated.
preventsClaim: a reopened stage throwing away recorded decisions

name: Bugfix route heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Bugfix route entry condition
does: Take the bugfix conversation when the dispatcher classified a bug fix or the recorded route is bugfix.
preventsClaim: running the feature path on a defect

name: Trace the code path
does: Read the source and trace the code path to model expected behavior; reproduce the bug when helpful.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: a goals doc written without understanding the bug)
costNote: unbounded source reading in the driver's own context

name: Ask batched repro questions
does: A vague description triggers batched questions: repro steps, expected vs actual, errors, intermittency.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: a fix built on a guess at the bug)

name: Match a test exception
does: Check the description against the config's Test exceptions and note which entry matched.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: demanding a regression test that cannot exist)

name: Rewrite goals as record
does: Rewrite goals.md with repro, expected, actual, matched exception, and the planned test location.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: the plan stage having no test location to use)

name: Bugfix human gate
does: Present the summary and have the user confirm the understanding and the test location.
preventsClaim: fixing the wrong bug or testing in the wrong place

name: No code before approval
does: No code, no test, and no plan before the bugfix gate approval.
preventsClaim: work starting before the user confirms the bug understanding

name: Feature routes heading
does: Section heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Critique step heading
does: Step heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Critique the goals document
does: Review goals.md for contradictions, gaps, complications, unstated assumptions, vagueness, alternatives.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: scope creep and unexamined assumptions downstream)

name: Critique is never output
does: Critique stays working notes: each finding becomes a question or a direct edit to goals.md.
preventsClaim: dumping critique prose on the user instead of acting on it

name: Question round heading
does: Step heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: One batched question round
does: Fold everything into one question round: the last point a human is guaranteed present.
preventsClaim: later stages needing a human who is no longer there
costNote: 1 round, though interaction.md caps a turn at 3 questions

name: Fold in critique questions
does: Include the critique points that need the user's call.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Fold in requirements questions
does: Include what requirements would ask: edge cases, errors, unstated behaviors, integration points, out of scope.
preventsClaim: the requirements stage needing to ask the user

name: Fold in mock questions
does: When a mock is coming, ask where the feature surfaces, which scenarios and states, what data.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Never ask visual detail
does: Do not ask about spacing, wording, or layout.
preventsClaim: burning the human round on detail the mock will show

name: Fold answers into goals
does: Fold the answers into goals.md.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: answers living only in the transcript)

name: Route step heading
does: Step heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Mock conditions decide route
does: Match the feature against config Mock conditions: any match is full, otherwise direct.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: mocking work that does not need it)
costNote: the full route adds the entire mock step

name: User override, never guess
does: User words override at any point; ask only if genuinely ambiguous, never guess, never ask when decided.
preventsClaim: silently guessing the route, or asking what conditions already decide

name: Mock step heading
does: Step heading, full route only.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Create mock artifacts
does: Create mocks.html and mocks.context.md in the mise directory.
preventsClaim: unstated
costNote: a full HTML mock written in the driver's context

name: Match the real product
does: Follow Mock guidance, read the UI code root, approximate real look and feel, apply matching guides.
preventsClaim: guessing at the product's look and feel

name: Mock every scenario and state
does: One HTML file, each scenario in a realistic window, unique IDs, one-line descriptions, variants offered.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Audit every new concept
does: Audit each concept the mock introduces and list survivors under New Concepts.
preventsClaim: a new concept becoming an assumption instead of a user decision

name: Cover the canonical states
does: Mock empty, loading, error, and every action's success and failure outcomes.
preventsClaim: a happy-path-only mock

name: Mock context template
does: Initialize mocks.context.md with Original Description, Clarifying Q&A, New Concepts, UI Tweaks Log.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: mock decisions lost before requirements)

name: Iterate and gate heading
does: Step heading.
preventsClaim: unstated

name: Iterate goals and mocks together
does: Present goals and mocks together, logging mock feedback to the tweaks log and goal edits to goals.md.
preventsClaim: unstated (implied: two separate review loops)
costNote: exit: the user approves (MF-287); no iteration bound stated

name: Human gate records route
does: Run the human gate per interaction.md, recording the decided route (full or direct).
preventsClaim: an approval recorded without the route it was decided under
